scripts.init:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
sceneState.desc = "You are in a dusty study. A heavy oak desk sits in the center. A bookshelf lines the wall. A locked door leads north."

-- Global progression state
sceneState.has_key = false
sceneState.door_open = false
sceneState.desk_searched = false
sceneState.books_read = false

-- List of all potential interactions
sceneState.interactions = {
    {id="search_desk", label="Search the desk", req_state=nil, block_state="desk_searched"},
    {id="read_books", label="Examine the bookshelf", req_state=nil, block_state="books_read"},
    {id="unlock_door", label="Unlock the north door", req_state="has_key", block_state="door_open"},
    {id="leave", label="Go through the north door", req_state="door_open", block_state=nil}
}

sceneState.cursor = 1
sceneState.visible_options = {}

local function updateOptions()
    sceneState.visible_options = {}
    for _, opt in ipairs(sceneState.interactions) do
        local req_met = (opt.req_state == nil) or (sceneState[opt.req_state] == true)
        local not_blocked = (opt.block_state == nil) or (sceneState[opt.block_state] == false)
        if req_met and not_blocked then
            table.insert(sceneState.visible_options, opt)
        end
    end
    
    if sceneState.cursor > #sceneState.visible_options then
        sceneState.cursor = math.max(1, #sceneState.visible_options)
    end
    
    local lines = {}
    for i, opt in ipairs(sceneState.visible_options) do
        if i == sceneState.cursor then
            table.insert(lines, "> " .. opt.label)
        else
            table.insert(lines, "  " .. opt.label)
        end
    end
    sceneState.options_text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
sceneState.updateOptions = updateOptions
updateOptions()
scripts.move_cursor:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local new_cursor = sceneState.cursor + sceneState.dy
if new_cursor >= 1 and new_cursor <= #sceneState.visible_options then
    sceneState.cursor = new_cursor
    sceneState.updateOptions()
end
scripts.action:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local selected = sceneState.visible_options[sceneState.cursor]
if not selected then return end

if selected.id == "search_desk" then
    sceneState.desk_searched = true
    sceneState.has_key = true
    sceneState.desc = "You rummage through the desk drawers. Hidden under some papers, you find a small brass key!"
elseif selected.id == "read_books" then
    sceneState.books_read = true
    sceneState.desc = "You pull a few books from the shelf. Most are dry histories of the local region. Nothing useful stands out."
elseif selected.id == "unlock_door" then
    sceneState.door_open = true
    sceneState.desc = "The brass key fits perfectly into the heavy iron lock. The door clicks open."
elseif selected.id == "leave" then
    sceneState.desc = "You step through the door and leave the dusty study behind... (Demo Complete)"
end

sceneState.updateOptions()
